zh.title: 实验究竟证明了什么？
zh.lead: 比较四种实验设计的延迟和 cache-read tokens，辨别收益、代价与证据边界。
zh.diagramLabel: 四种设计使用共同零基线的实验指标条形图
zh.p50: 任务完成时间 p50 / 分钟
zh.p95: 任务完成时间 p95 / 分钟
zh.cache: 每轮 cache-read tokens / 百万
zh.workload: 每轮约 300 条消息，其中约 20 条工作请求；每种设计运行 5 次。
zh.otherPortion: 约 280 条聊天、反馈、取消和 CI
zh.compare: 相对 Super-agent 的差值（同一指标单位）
zh.insight0: 双层架构把执行分出去；该实验中 p95 较低，但 cache-read tokens 高于单 Session 两种设计。
zh.insight1: 去掉透传后 cache-read tokens 从 23.2M 增至 31.8M，约增加 37%。完成时间相近，不能据此说透传显著降低延迟。
zh.insight2: 中性提示下 5 次运行均未委派，主 Session 被新消息打断。这里的延迟不是模型解决真实代码题的成绩。
zh.insight3: 优先委派提示在 5 次中委派 4 次；剩下一次自行处理，形成长尾。提示能帮助，但没有形成固定职责约束。
zh.caption: 数值来自文章 §7.1；条形从零开始，共用各指标量纲。没有原始逐任务日志，因此不伪造完成曲线或统计显著性。
zh.limit0: 编码工作由只消耗时间的工具模拟；实验主要测调度与协调，不测真实编码质量。
zh.limit1: cache-read tokens 是一种 token 指标，不包含完整输入输出及定价信息，不能直接转成总 API 成本。
zh.limit2: 每种设计只有 5 次运行，环境简化；文章称结果是初步指示，不是普适性能保证。
zh.question: 去掉透传后 p95 从 15.7 变成 15.5，是否说明透传有害？
zh.answer: 不能这样推断。样本小且时间相近；该消融支持的清晰收益是降低 cache-read tokens 和 Router 推理开销。
zh.step0Explanation: 相同消息流驱动四种设计；任务执行用耗时工具替代，所以比较的是系统组织方式。
zh.step1Title: 比较延迟分布的两个摘要
zh.step1Explanation: p50 描述中间位置，p95 描述尾部。它们不能还原每个任务的运行轨迹。
zh.step2Explanation: 选择去掉透传并切换 token 指标，看它减少了什么；不要把节省 token 自动解释为更快完成。
zh.step3Title: 提示词与系统职责不同
zh.step3Explanation: 对比两种单 Session 提示。允许委派，不保证每次都会委派，也不保证稳定尾部延迟。

en.title: What do the experiments actually establish?
en.lead: Compare latency and cache-read tokens across four designs, separating benefits, tradeoffs, and evidence limits.
en.diagramLabel: Experimental metrics for four designs with a shared zero baseline
en.workload: About 300 messages per run, including about 20 work requests; 5 runs per design.
en.otherPortion: About 280 chat, follow-up, cancellation, and CI messages
en.selected: Three metrics for the selected design
en.compare: Difference from Super-agent, in the same metric units
en.insight0: The two-level design separates execution. In this workload it has a lower p95, but more cache-read tokens than both single-session designs.
en.insight1: Removing pass-through raises cache-read tokens from 23.2M to 31.8M, about 37%. Completion times are similar; this does not establish a substantial latency reduction.
en.insight2: The neutral prompt delegates in none of 5 runs; new messages interrupt the main session. These latencies are not real coding scores.
en.insight3: The delegation prompt delegates in 4 of 5 runs. The remaining self-executed run creates a long tail. Prompting helps without imposing a fixed responsibility boundary.
en.caption: Values come from §7.1. Bars start at zero and share a scale per metric. No raw task logs are available, so no completion traces or statistical significance are fabricated.
en.limit0: Coding work is simulated by a time-consuming tool. The experiment tests scheduling and coordination, not real code quality.
en.limit1: Cache-read tokens do not contain full input/output or pricing information and cannot directly yield total API cost.
en.limit2: Only 5 runs per design and simplified environments provide preliminary evidence, not a universal performance guarantee.
en.question: Does a p95 change from 15.7 to 15.5 show that pass-through is harmful?
en.answer: No. The sample is small and times are similar. The clearer benefit supported by this ablation is lower cache-read tokens and Router inference overhead.
en.step0Explanation: The same message workload drives four designs. A timed tool replaces execution, so the comparison concerns system organization.
en.step1Explanation: p50 summarizes the middle and p95 the tail. Neither reconstructs individual task traces.
en.step2Explanation: Select the no-pass-through design and token metric. Token savings do not automatically imply faster completion.
en.step3Explanation: Compare the single-session prompts. Available delegation does not guarantee delegation on every run or stable tail latency.
